findings.summary: The slider shows 800 but the field shows 750, so the user can't tell which monthly deposit the result is based on. That makes the main figure unreliable.
The 2% inflation rate sits behind a button and the main line only says 'in today's money'. This is a wish for more openness; the reader doesn't say the button fails, so it isn't listed problem 1.
Tax appears as a huge pink bar labelled '84% of loss'. It reads like a loss and is unclear, so the user may misread a main cost figure.
The reader doesn't recognise the recommended fund manager. That is personal hesitation, not a fault in the page.
The filter chips and fee terms use jargon the reader doesn't understand. The complaint is general and mostly about secondary filters, so it reads as an annoyance rather than a blocker.
